in_marathi.name: Alkesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of all senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alkesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Alkesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'alaksha' meaning 'without limits' and 'shasana' meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. This name signifies a person who rules over all senses and desires. In Hindu mythology, Alkesh is a name associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and war.
